headline: A browser-based global dashboard visualizes live flight and ship telemetry
lede: This project aggregates real-time transponder and sensor data into a photorealistic 3D environment. Users can navigate global movement with professional-grade sensor overlays directly in their browser.

headline: A self-hosted CRM automates WhatsApp sales workflows with integrated AI agents
lede: DeskcommCRM provides a sovereign platform for businesses to manage communications without recurring subscription fees. It includes robust containerized deployment tools and automated maintenance routines for long-term reliability.

headline: A community archive maps the evolution of hidden AI system prompts
lede: This repository catalogs the foundational directives and behavioral guardrails extracted from leading generative models. It serves as an essential historical reference for developers and researchers tracking AI steering mechanisms.

headline: Streamline iOS sideloading with this cross-platform management utility
lede: Managing custom IPAs and certificates often requires complex command-line intervention. This tool automates the signing and lockdown process, providing a clean graphical interface for hardware development workflows.

headline: Bypass regional traffic filtering with specialized packet modification tools
lede: This utility intercepts and filters network traffic to evade Deep Packet Inspection on restrictive networks. It provides a lightweight, local-first alternative to traditional VPN services for maintaining service connectivity.

headline: A multi-agent framework automates end-to-end mathematical research paper generation
lede: The platform orchestrates specialized roles—modeler, coder, and writer—to execute complex mathematical modeling tasks. It leverages RAG-based knowledge retrieval and automated validation to produce high-quality research output.

headline: Automate your home media library with this sophisticated PVR server
lede: Sonarr monitors RSS feeds to handle the acquisition, sorting, and renaming of television episodes. It integrates seamlessly with download clients and media servers to ensure a hands-off, high-definition viewing experience.

headline: A self-hosted AI trading terminal monitors one thousand global markets
lede: This modular bot features a conversational interface for executing multi-chain DeFi strategies and whale tracking. It employs local semantic memory and circuit-breaker risk management to ensure operational safety.

headline: A custom Android TV client delivers an ad-free streaming experience
lede: SmartTube provides a highly granular, distraction-free interface for living room hardware. It includes advanced features like 8K support and integrated sponsor segment skipping to reclaim the viewing experience.

headline: A collection of one hundred modular AI applications for immediate deployment
lede: This resource provides production-ready templates for agentic workflows ranging from research to voice-enabled assistants. Each project is designed to be cloned and launched with minimal configuration for rapid prototyping.
